text:
Ivy Chen: Quick sync : Helmsley reserved pool bring-up is T+1 at 09:00 PT. Need final call on steady vs burst carve, autoscale ramps, and whether to soft-throttle analytic batch routes. Tagging @Marco Li and @Ravi (CSM).
Marco Li: Looked at their baseline: 36k tokens/min committed. Recommend 27k baseline (75%) + 9k burst for first 48h. Add KV-prefix priming 12-15m pre-run.
Ravi (CSM): Customer agreed to 25% headroom for 48h if flagged as "bring-up" and not billed as overage. They want a 15-min enablement after first run and daily 10-min health notes.
Marco Li: Plan for two-phase load: (1) 12m priming at low qps, (2) 10m steady at 27k, (3) 90s controlled spike to 40k. Autoscale: aggressive scale-up window 25s, cooldown 60s while warmup. If p95 > 300ms for >90s, enable 5% diversion to rw-quantized.
Marco Li: k6 snippet for spike:```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rw-dedicated-7b', prompt:'test'}), { headers: { 'Authorization':'Bearer $TEST' } });
}
```
ops-bot: Load test scheduled by Marco Li: job_id=hlm-warm-77, start=2024-08-01T02:30:00Z, runner=k6-3.3
Marco Li: Smoke run quick results: peak=41k rps (35s spike), avg=30.5k, errors=0.7% (mostly 429s on /batch/analytics), p95=275ms. Cache hit-rate improved 68% -> 91% after priming. Artifacts: https://internal.redwood/jobs/hlm-warm-77/logs
Ivy Chen: Good notes. Action items: (1) set autoscale windows per Marco (25s up / 60s cooldown), (2) apply soft-throttle on /batch/analytics during spikes, (3) tag metrics with "bringup:Helmsley", (4) enable 5% quantized diversion as fallback. Assign @Marco Li + @Ravi (CSM).
Ravi (CSM): Invite for 15-min walkthrough and daily digest cadence sent to Helmsley ops. Also posted short feedback form: https://forms.gle/helmsley-warmup
Marco Li: I'll push the cooldown + throttle rules and add a dashboard tile for the daily digest. Will monitor first 48h and report back.
Ivy Chen: Reconvene after 48h for post-mortem and renewal-readiness summary. :white_check_mark:
